newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures mixed after APIs.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures mixed after APIs.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices were mixed in light trade following a weekly inventory report from the American Petroleum Institute.
A 3.1 million drawdown in gasoline gave traders incentive to snap up contracts after-hours, sending the contract up 0.18 cents a gallon to 69.95 cents amid 323 lots traded.
Front-month heating oil rose 0.21 cents a gallon to 73.75 cents as 223 lots changed hands. Around 269 traded in all months.

January crude on ACCESS fell 70 cents to from the settle to $25.01 a barrel, after traders claimed a 4.6 million fall in stocks was neutral. 587 lots traded in January and 1,503 overall, traders said.
